newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Unza up on asset reshuffling rumours.
newsitem.headline: Unza up on asset reshuffling rumours.

text.p: Unza Holdings Bhd shares gained sharply on Wednesday amid rumours of asset reshuffling by Malaysian businessman Vincent Tan, dealers said.
Tan is head of the diverse Berjaya Group companies whose stable also includes Unza, a distributor of personal care and household products.
Executives at Unza could not be reached for comment, but a source close to the company asserted, "There is nothing material in the offing that could contribute to the increase in the stock."
Unza was the sharpest net gainer in the market on Wednesday, rising 4.50 ringgit or 22.28 percent to 24.70 ringgit.

Dealers noted that other Tan-affiliated companies were also firm. Bridgecon Bhd, an engineering and construction concern, rose 2.70 to 19.60 ringgit, while hospital operator Hospital Pantai Bhd added 1.30 to 12.50 ringgit.
